functions.name: ASK
functions.description: Ask Jev a typed question about some text. Mode is "choice", "score" or "noul", optionally with an output such as "choice:probs" or "noul:bool".

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: choice | score | noul, optionally followed by :output (e.g. choice:confidence, score:label, noul:bool:0.7).

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text (or cell/range) Jev should evaluate. Blank returns blank.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Options, rubric levels or the yes/no question. Prefix an item with ? to make it the question. Accepts text or ranges.

functions.name: CHOICE
functions.description: Jev picks one of the options for the text and returns its label.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text (or cell/range) Jev should classify.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Two or more labels. Use "label | description" or a 2-column range for descriptions, and "?question" to set the question.

functions.name: SCORE
functions.description: Jev places the text on an ordered rubric and returns the expected level (can fall between levels).

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text (or cell/range) Jev should score.

parameters.name: levels
parameters.description: Two to ten rubric level descriptions, lowest (level 0) first. Use "?question" to set the question.

functions.name: NOUL
functions.description: Jev answers a yes/no question about the text and returns the probability of yes (0 to 1).

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text (or cell/range) Jev should evaluate.

parameters.name: question
parameters.description: The yes/no question or statement, e.g. "The customer is asking for a refund".

parameters.name: when_true
parameters.description: Optional description of what counts as yes.

parameters.name: when_false
parameters.description: Optional description of what counts as no.

functions.name: STATE
functions.description: Builds a JSON object from a header range and a value range, so Jev sees named fields you can reference in questions with `backticks`.

functions.name: MODELS
functions.description: Lists the Jev models available to your API key (spills name, description, release date).
